items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Eddie Lang, the guitar player? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I knew the other big guy that died...

ctx.x: Yeah, I liked the band. I liked, I think they made Singin' the Blues. Yeah, yeah. I liked their band. Very good band.
Did you know Eddie Lang, the guitar player?
No, I knew the other big guy that died, he was a wonderful guitar man. Great big fella. I can't think of his name. He was very popular in the 20s. Can't recall the guy's name.
